meet-easy.text: कॉफ़ी शॉप के सामने मिलते हैं।

gloss.en: Let us meet in front of the coffee shop.

end.text: हाँ, ठीक है! वहीं मिलते हैं।

gloss.en: Yes, okay! See you there.

setting: The AI tutor plays a colleague. The pantry of an IT office in Bengaluru, nine-thirty in the morning. The colleague is making tea.

goal.en: Say yes, please give you some tea.
Say you're fine but a bit tired, and ask how they are.
goal.ko: 괜찮지만 좀 피곤하다고 하고 동료는 어떤지 물어보세요.

match: मैं ठीक हूँ, आप कैसे हैं
ठीक हूँ, थोड़ा थका हूँ। आप?
ठीक हूँ, थोड़ी थकी हूँ। और आप

goal.en: Say yes, at one o'clock.

match: ठीक है, एक बजे चलते हैं

goal.en: Say okay, see you.

hello.text: गुड मॉर्निंग! चाय चलेगी?

gloss.en: Good morning! Fancy some tea?
Will you have tea?

how.text: यह लो। और, क्या हाल है आज?

gloss.en: Here you go. So, how are things today?
Is everything okay?

tired.text: मेरा भी यही हाल है। बहुत काम है।

gloss.en: Same here. There is a lot of work.
There's a lot of work.

lunch.text: आज लंच कब है? साथ चलें?

gloss.en: When is lunch today? Shall we go together?
Lunch when? One o'clock?
Sure! See you at one.

end2.text: ठीक है, फिर कभी। अच्छा दिन हो!

gloss.en: Okay, some other time. Have a good day!
Bye!

setting: The AI tutor plays a station staff member. A metro smart-card recharge machine at Bengaluru's MG Road metro station. The staff member is nearby.

goal.en: Say you don't understand this machine.

match: मुझे यह मशीन समझ नहीं आई
माफ़ कीजिए, मुझे यह समझ नहीं आया

goal.en: Ask them to say it slowly.
Put the card down and ask: like this?
goal.ko: 카드를 놓고 이렇게 하는 거냐고 물어보세요.

goal.en: Say two hundred.
Thank them for the help.

hello.text: जी, कोई दिक्कत है?

gloss.en: Yes, is there a problem?
Need help?

how.text: कार्ड यहाँ रखिए, फिर अमाउंट चुनिए, फिर पैसे डालिए।

gloss.en: Put the card here, then choose the amount, then insert the money.
gloss.ko: 카드를 여기 놓고, 금액을 고르고, 돈을 넣으세요.

gloss.en: First put the card here.

slow.text: ठीक है। पहले कार्ड यहाँ रखिए।

gloss.en: Okay. First put the card here.
Put the card here.

amount.text: अब अमाउंट चुनिए। कितने का रिचार्ज करना है?

gloss.en: Now choose the amount. How much do you want to recharge?
gloss.ko: 이제 금액 고르세요. 얼마 충전할 거예요?

amount-easy.text: सौ का या दो सौ का?

gloss.en: A hundred or two hundred?
Now put in the money. Done!
Put the money here.

end.text: कोई बात नहीं। आपकी यात्रा अच्छी हो!

gloss.en: No problem. Have a good journey!

setting: The AI tutor plays a classmate. The corridor outside a Hindi classroom at a language institute in Mysuru, after the evening class.

goal.en: Say you're going home now.
Say he's your friend.
Say no, and ask them.
Say see you, bye.

hello.text: उफ़, क्लास लंबी थी! अब कहाँ जाना है?

gloss.en: Phew, class was long! Where are you off to now?
gloss.ko: 휴, 수업 길었다! 이제 어디 가?

gloss.en: Going home now?

who.text: अच्छा! वह लड़का कौन है? तुम्हें बुला रहा है।

gloss.en: Okay! Who is that boy? He's calling you.
gloss.ko: 그렇구나! 저 남자애 누구야? 너 부르는데.

gloss.en: Who is that boy?

next.text: अगली क्लास कब है, पता है?

gloss.en: Do you know when the next class is?
Next class? When?
On Monday, at five in the evening.
On Monday at five.

end.text: ठीक है, सोमवार को मिलते हैं। बाय!

gloss.en: Okay, see you on Monday. Bye!
